scope: One real Gemini VP02 call on a synthetic CLEAN_PROMPT fixture. This is a local regression, not a new end-to-end persona run or VP01 validation.
observations: Three concrete garment options and two concrete material options: no padding to five.
The yem option requires a covering combination in description and decision_text; description explicitly covers shoulders, chest, waist and back and excludes standalone yem.
Layered tu than is permitted with a covering inner garment, rather than banning all layered designs.
limits: The fixture explicitly supplies coverage and no-standalone requirements. One successful sample does not prove the template alone reliably infers them from every sparse school brief.
The yem decision_text is less precise than description. Downstream resolution must retain the hard coverage requirements, not infer that an open jacket alone suffices.
A generic claim of suitability for university clothing rules is not verification of a specific campus rule. No campus regulation or material performance was verified.
decision: No further prompt change justified by this sample. Preserve the fixture for local regression, and reopen this issue if coverage is lost downstream.
